paite: Huan, Toupan, Noa kiangah, nang leh na inkuanpihte tengteng longah lut un; nang jaw tulai khangthak lakah ka mitmuhin mi diktat na hihna ka honthei hi.
english: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

paite: Sa siang chiteng lakah, a pa leh a lawmnu, kop sagih jelin: sa sianglou laka, a pa leh a lawmnu chiat toh, kop khat jel, na kiangah na pi ding hi;
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

paite: Tunga leng vasa laka zong, a nu leh a pa chiat, kop sagih jelin, leitunga chi khah dinga hinsak dingin.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

paite: Ni sagihin a sam laia, huai khit chiangin leitung ah ni sawm li leh jan sawm li sungteng vuah ka zu sak dinga; ka thil hing bawl chiteng leitung akipan ka hihmang ding, a chi a.
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. Every living thing that I have made, I will destroy from the surface of the ground.”

paite: Huchiin, Noain Toupan a kianga thu a piak tengteng bang jelin ahihta.
english: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

paite: Huan, leitunga tuichim a hongtun lain Noa kum za guka upa ahi.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

paite: Huan, tuichim a tun ding jiakin Noa longah a luta, a tapate leh a ji leh a tapate jite leng a kiangah a lut sam uh.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the waters of the flood.

paite: Sa siang laka leng, sa sianglou laka leng, vasa laka leng, leitunga khupboha pai chiteng laka leng,
english: Clean animals, animals that are not clean, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

paite: Pathianin Noa kianga thu a piak bangin, a nu leh a pa chiat, a kop kopin, Noa kiangah longah a luta uh.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

paite: Huan, ni sagih nungin leitung ah a tungta.
english: It happened after the seven days, that the waters of the flood came on the earth.

paite: Noa kum za guk a hih kum, a kha nihna ni sawm leh ni sagih niin, huai ni mahin tui thuk zapi nak tengteng a hongpuak jaka, van tohlette leng a hong kihongta hi.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep were burst open, and the sky’s windows were opened.

paite: Huan, ni sawm li leh jan sawm li sung teng leitungah vuahpi a zutaa.
english: The rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.

paite: Huai ni mahin Noa te, Noa tapa Sem te, Ham te, Japheth te, Noa ji te longah a luta ua, a tapa jite thum leng a kiangah a lut sam ua;
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship;

paite: Amaute a lut ua, sa chiteng amau chi omdan bang chiatin, ganhing leitunga khupboha pai chiteng amau chi omdan bang chiatin, vasa chiteng, amau chi omdan bang chiatin, vasa chiteng, kah nei chiteng leng a lut uh.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

paite: Huchiin, sa tengteng hinna hatna pai himhimte, a kop kopin Noa kiangah longah a luta uh.
english: They went to Noah into the ship, by pairs of all flesh with the breath of life in them.

paite: Huan, a lutte Pathianin a kianga thu a piak bangin sa tengteng laka a nu leh a pa jelin a lut uhi: huan Toupan amah a khak khumta hi.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; and Yahweh shut him in.

paite: Huan, tuichim leitung ah ni sawm li sung teng a tunga; tui a hongkhanga, long a lama, leitung tunglamah a dom kangta hi.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

paite: Huan, tui a hong om juajua a, leitung tunglamah a khanin a hong khangta hi, long tui tungah a kilam jel hi.
english: The waters prevailed, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

paite: Huan, leitung tunglamah tui nakpiin a hongom juajua taa; van nuaia tang sang tengteng a tumkhin vekta hi.
english: The waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

paite: Tong sawm leh tong nga hiala sangin tui a hongom zeizoia; tangte tupmangin a omta uhi.
english: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.

paite: Huchiin, sa leitunga tangthei tengteng, vasate, gante, sate, ganhing leitunga khupboha pai chitengte, mi chitengte toh a si khinvekta uh:
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

paite: A nak ua hinna kha hatna omna tengteng, gama om khempeuh te, a si khin vekta uh.
english: All in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, of all that was on the dry land, died.

paite: Huchiin, leitunga thil hing chiteng omte, mite, gante, ganhingte, tunga leng vasate toh hihmanin a om uh; lei akipan hihmanin a omta uh: Noa longa a kianga omte kia hawiin a om uhi,Huan, tui tuh ni ja leh ni sawm nga sungteng leitungah a omta hi.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

paite: Huan, tui tuh ni ja leh ni sawm nga sungteng leitungah a omta hi.
english: The waters prevailed on the earth one hundred fifty days.
